verdict.rationale: Mem0 ships an official CLI (docs.mem0.ai/platform/cli) that supports add, search, list, update, and delete of memories directly from the terminal, explicitly designed to work for both humans and AI agents, and is corroborated by a probe confirming the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review of the CLI itself (evidence is vendor docs only) and no detail on installation/distribution mechanics (npm/pip/binary).
